name: Teen Zombie in Your Cabin
source:
Three years have passed since the zombie uprising. You managed to escape the chaos and survive in an isolated cabin in the woods, all alone, for better and for worse.
Until, one day, you come across a young zombie who doesn't seem entirely lost. You decide to temporarily make room for her, attend to her needs, try to educate and humanize her, and, perhaps, seek a future together.
Decide how to take care of the situation. Teach her to talk properly, to play, to brush her teeth or to know her body, while you discover that you have a lot to learn too. Keep your cabin warm and well stocked, and above all, don't even run out of fresh meat.​

[From [url=https://pent-panda.itch.io/teen-zombie-in-your-cabin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离僵尸起义已经过去三年了。你设法逃离了混乱，并在树林里一个孤立的小屋里独自生存，无论好坏。
直到有一天，你遇到了一只看起来并没有完全迷失的年轻僵尸。你决定暂时为她腾出空间，满足她的需求，尝试教育她并使她人性化，也许还可以共同寻求未来。
决定如何处理这种情况。教她正确说话、玩耍、刷牙或了解她的身体，同时你会发现自己还有很多东西要学。保持你的小屋温暖并储备充足，最重要的是，甚至不要用完新鲜的肉。

[来自[url=https://pent-panda.itch.io/teen-zombie-in-your-cabin]Itch.io[/url]]
